propositions: Commit subject lines exceeding 50 characters must be rejected locally with an error message naming the offending line and its length.
Commit body lines exceeding 72 characters must be rejected locally with an error message naming each offending line and its length.
Conforming commits must be accepted and must still receive Gerrit's Change-Id trailer despite the local commit-msg hook being chained alongside Gerrit's existing hook in migration mode.

Specific commit message patterns must be exempted from the 72-character body line check: trailers matching ^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*:\s, TAG= lines matching ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*=, fenced code blocks between triple-backtick markers, lines beginning with 4+ spaces or a tab, table rows beginning with |, and lines containing only unsplittable tokens (URLs, paths, dotted identifiers).
Git scaffolding such as comment lines and git commit --verbose diff sections must not trigger false positives.

The checker must never mutate the commit message and must be configurable to install via bare pre-commit install without explicit --hook-type flags using default_install_hook_types in .pre-commit-config.yaml.
